```{ojs}
//| label: fig-partition-voronoi
//| fig-cap: A decomposition of the sample space $\Omega$ into a partition $B_1,\ldots,B_k$. Subsets $B_i$ are mutually exclusive and exhaustive; every point in $\Omega$ lies in exactly one $B_i$.
//| fig-align: center

{
  const width = 720, height = 360;
  const pad = 20;

  // Soft region fills share the same identities as the figure series palette.
  const fills = [
    "var(--plot-fill-1)",
    "var(--plot-fill-2)",
    "var(--plot-fill-3)",
    "var(--plot-fill-5)",
    "var(--plot-fill-4)"
  ];
  const col = i => fills[i % fills.length];

  // seeded RNG so "Reseed" changes layout deterministically per click
  const rng = d3.randomLcg(reseed || 1);

  // generate n sites inside Ω (inset by padding)
  const sites = d3.range(n).map(i => ({
    name: `B${i+1}`,
    x: pad + rng() * (width - 2*pad),
    y: pad + rng() * (height - 2*pad)
  }));

  const delaunay = d3.Delaunay.from(sites, d => d.x, d => d.y);
  const vor = delaunay.voronoi([pad, pad, width - pad, height - pad]);

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", height)
    .style("background", "var(--plot-bg)")
    .style("color", "var(--plot-fg)")
    .style("font-family", bodyFont)
    .style("font-size", "14px");

  // --- defs: rounded-rect clip for Ω ---
  const defs = svg.append("defs");
  defs.append("clipPath")
    .attr("id", "clipOmega")
    .append("rect")
      .attr("x", pad).attr("y", pad)
      .attr("width", width - 2*pad).attr("height", height - 2*pad)
      .attr("rx", 10);

  // cells (clipped to rounded Ω so no sharp outer box)
  const g = svg.append("g").attr("clip-path", "url(#clipOmega)");
  const polys = [];  // store polygons for centroid labelling

  for (let i = 0; i < sites.length; i++) {
    const poly = vor.cellPolygon(i);
    if (!poly) continue;
    polys.push({ i, poly, name: sites[i].name });
    g.append("path")
      .attr("d", d3.line()(poly))
      .attr("fill", col(i))
      .attr("stroke", "currentColor")
      .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.28);
  }

  // label font size adapts to n (clamped between 10px and 14px)
  const fz = Math.max(10, Math.min(14, 16 - 0.5 * (n - 3)));

  // labels at polygon centroids (true centre for convex Voronoi cells)
  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(polys.map(d => {
      const [cx, cy] = d3.polygonCentroid(d.poly);
      return { x: cx, y: cy, name: d.name };
    }))
    .join("text")
      .attr("x", d => d.x)
      .attr("y", d => d.y)
      .text(d => d.name)
      .attr("font-weight", 700)
      .attr("fill", "currentColor")
      .attr("font-size", `${fz}px`)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("dominant-baseline", "middle");

  // Ω frame (single rounded rectangle, drawn last)
  svg.append("rect")
    .attr("x", pad).attr("y", pad)
    .attr("width", width - 2*pad).attr("height", height - 2*pad)
    .attr("rx", 10)
    .attr("fill", "none")
    .attr("stroke", "currentColor")
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.55);

  // Ω label
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", pad + 8).attr("y", pad + 16)
    .text("Ω")
    .style("font-weight", 400)
    .style("font-size", "18px")
    .attr("fill", "currentColor");

  return svg.node();
}
```

```{ojs}

// Build the two inputs only, in a side-by-side grid
viewof controls = {
  const resBtn = Inputs.button("Reseed points");
  resBtn.classList.add("btn-resim");

  const leftForm = Inputs.form(
    { n: Inputs.range([3, 50], { value: 10, step: 1, label: md`${tex`k`}: number of sets` }) },
    { submit: false }
  );
  const rightForm = Inputs.form({ reseed: resBtn }, { submit: false });

  const root = html`<div class="controls-wrap">
    <details class="controls-root" open>
      <summary>Partition controls</summary>
      <div class="controls-grid">
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Number of regions</h4></div>
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Randomisation</h4></div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>`;

  const grid = root.querySelector(".controls-grid");
  const leftCol = grid.children[0];
  const rightCol = grid.children[1];
  leftCol.append(leftForm);
  rightCol.append(rightForm);

  const getValue = () => ({ ...leftForm.value, ...rightForm.value });
  const update = () => {
    root.value = getValue();
    root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  grid.addEventListener("input", update);
  queueMicrotask(update);
  return root;
}

// reactive bindings for the plot
n = controls.n
reseed = controls.reseed
```
